## Alumni {.lab-section}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(readr); library(knitr)
alum <- read_csv("people/alumni.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
alum$Name <- ifelse(is.na(alum$Link) | alum$Link == "",
                    alum$Name,
                    sprintf('<a href="%s">%s</a>', alum$Link, alum$Name))
kable(alum[, c("Name","Role")], format = "html", escape = FALSE,
      col.names = c("", ""), table.attr = 'class="table"')
```
